name: New York Style Pizza with Kimchi, Soppressata, and Maitake Mushrooms

ingredients.name: basic new york pizza dough, divided

instructions.primary_message: At least 45 minutes before baking, place a baking stone or steel on an oven rack set to the top position and preheat oven to 290°C (550°F). Toss mushrooms in a medium bowl with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.

Turn single dough ball out onto lightly flour surface. Gently press out dough into rough 20-cm circle, leaving outer 2.5-cm higher than the rest. Gently stretch dough by draping over knuckles into a 30 to 36-cm circle about 0.5-cm thick. Transfer to pizza peel.

Spread approximately 2/3 cup of sauce evenly over surface of crust, leaving 1.5 to 2.5-cm border along edge. Evenly spread 1/3 of mozzarella over sauce. Top with 1/3 of kimchi, 1/3 of soppressata, 1/3 of mushrooms, 1/3 of scallions, and 1/3 of grated ginger. Slide pizza onto stone or steel and bake until cheese is melted, coppa has started to crisp, and crust underbelly is spotty brown, 6 to 12 minutes total. Remove from oven with metal pizza peel, sprinkle with 28 g Parmesan, transfer to cutting board, slice, and serve. Repeat steps 3 and 4 with remaining ingredients to make 2 additional pizzas.

description: Pizza with spicy kimchi, soppressata, and scallions on a soft and crisp New York-style crust.
notes: Optional substitutions: thinly sliced hot soppressata → pepperoni
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
